12.1 Introduction to Organic Chemistry and Organic Compounds What are the constituents of NaCl and CH4? Organic compounds are those compounds which are formed by covalent bonds. Covalent bonds are formed by sharing the electrons within the atoms. The chemistry which deals with the study of those organic compounds is called organic chemistry.
